name: US equity stress
summary: VIX rose to about 31 on 25 Nov, above the 30 Alert line; S&P 500 about 9.1% below its 52-week high
state: The VIX traded near 31.1 on 25 Nov, above the 30 Alert line and up 84% over the month, after peaking near 35.9 on 20 Nov (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 stood near 7,108, about 9.1% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and 8.2% lower on the month, with a worst day of -3.7% in five sessions (Yahoo Finance). The VIX reading sets the Alert; the drawdown is inside the Watch band and no circuit breaker tripped.
for_you: US markets are in a stress regime with large daily swings. Pensions and investment funds with US equity exposure may show sharp short-term moves in value.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
